use_memorytrace_context_manager: use the MemoryTrace context manager to track peak GPU and CPU memory usage during model training
print_memory_stats: print memory statistics including peak CUDA memory allocated and CPU peak memory consumed
convert_bytes_to_gb: convert a byte value to gigabytes using the byte2gb utility function
monitor_cpu_peak_memory: monitor CPU peak memory usage in a background thread via the peak_monitor_func method
get_cpu_memory_used: get the resident set size memory for the current process using the cpu_mem_used method
